title: Preserve GPIF bend control roles with nonmonotonic offsets
scope: Allow valid standard GPIF origin/middle/destination control tuples to survive export even when destination offset precedes a middle offset.
acceptance: Reproduce the current export rejection for canon-audio-track.gp in GP7 and GP8: note 177 authors offsets 0, 50, 50, 35 in control-role order.
Preserve those roles and exact offsets in exported GPIF and Go reparse; pinned AlphaTab must consume the result with the same retained controls.
Do not sort controls or silently replace their positions. Keep malformed role counts, invalid numeric values and genuinely unrepresentable shapes diagnosable at their applicable boundary.
Add focused public-API validation/export tests, including a normal monotonic curve and a nonmonotonic but valid standard tuple, without weakening unrelated score invariants.
exclusions: This is not permission to accept every unordered arbitrary curve. The exact-offset representation is owned by #60.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce the current export rejection for canon-audio-track.gp in GP7 and GP8: note 177 authors offsets 0, 50, 50, 35 in control-role order. See the linked investigation decision and review receipt for the confirmed baseline.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.

implementation-ready: The fixture authors destination 35 after middle offsets 50. Generic monotonic validation rejects a standard GPIF role tuple; the precision prerequisite avoids preserving only rounded coordinates.
